title: Independent reading: Romans 5:1–11
subtitle: Trace a chain of claims, grounds, and results.
overview: Romans 5:1–11 advances by participial grounding, repeated καί additions, γάρ explanations, and a final καυχώμενοι response. Draw the chain before translating every phrase.
Keep present claims, past divine action, and future-oriented expectation distinct in your reading notes.

items.grc: δικαιωθέντες οὖν ἐκ πίστεως εἰρήνην ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν θεόν.
items.en: Therefore, having been justified by faith, we have peace with God.

items.grc: ἡ δὲ ἐλπὶς οὐ καταισχύνει, ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκκέχυται ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν.
items.en: And hope does not put to shame, because the love of God has been poured into our hearts.
